content.value: A cold-finished shaft, AISI 1141, is to transmit power that varies from 200 to 100 and back to 200 hp in each revolution at a speed of 600 rpm. The power is received by a 20 in. spur gear A and delivered by a 10 in. spur gear C. The tangential forces have each been converted into a force (A and C shown) and a couple (not shown). The radial component R of the tooth load is to be ignored in the initial design. Let N = 2 and, considering varying stresses with the maximum shear, compute the shaft diameter,
